paper_length_policy.notes: Submission Information / Submission Rules / FAQ: six content pages plus one references-only page, one PDF.

reference_page_policy.notes: Additional reference page contains references only; not seven interchangeable content pages.

appendix_supplementary_policy.notes: UNKNOWN: no verified applicable official rule retained for this exact edition, track and stage.

template_requirements.notes: Submission Rules and FAQ: required template family, two columns, 9 or 10 pt. No literal LaTeX class/options verified; do not infer them from publisher defaults.

value.scope: Remove author names, affiliations and PDF author metadata; cite own work in third person without omitted-for-blind-review placeholders.

anonymity_requirements.notes: Submission Rules; Review Process; FAQ on self-citation.

value: Technical quality and originality; demonstrate advances over relevant prior approaches.
Quantify results and support claims with experiments, preferably industry-strength designs or accepted benchmarks.
Discuss limitations; present a clear, well-organized English manuscript.

value.disclosure: Generated content requires a separate Content Generated by AI section identifying the models, affected sections and extent of use. Editing, grammar, translation and knowledge retrieval disclosure is recommended but not required.
value.authorship: LLMs cannot be authors; human authors remain responsible for all content.

ai_disclosure_requirements.notes: Policy on AI/LLMs/ChatGPT: conditional generation permission and disclosure are distinct from author responsibility; exact research-submission policy.

artifact_reproducibility_policy.notes: UNKNOWN: no verified applicable official rule retained for this exact edition, track and stage.

items: Use an approximately 100-word abstract to state contribution, impact and results; leave space for final author details and acknowledgments.

writing_style_guidance.notes: Submission Rules; not a representative-paper style study.

items: For architecture/systems or HW/SW co-design claims, identify design constraints and distinguish measured hardware, simulation and analytical estimates.
Use fair baselines and claim-relevant performance, energy, area, timing, reliability or design-effort metrics; do not require every metric for every paper.

field_specific_evaluation_priorities.notes: Independent Paper Craft methodology, not official venue criteria or a claim about all fields covered by this conference.

notes: DAC means Design Automation Conference, branded The Chips to Systems Conference. research maps only to regular Research Manuscript submissions (AI, Design, EDA, Security, Systems categories), not Engineering Tracks, special sessions or WIP posters. These rules are exact edition/stage snapshots; 2026 ACM formatting is not a fallback for 2027 IEEE formatting. Domain advice remains limited to architecture/systems and hardware/software design research.
